✓ Northwestern University.question: Like other _____ universities, Northwestern was transformed by World War II (1939–1945)
✓ Northwestern University.fact: Like other American universities, Northwestern was transformed by World War II (1939–1945). In 1948, prominent anthropologist Melville J. Herskovits set up the Program of African Studies at Northwestern, the first center of its kind at an American academic institution.

✓ Northwestern University.question: At one time, Northwestern had the longest losing streak in _____ I-A, losing 34 consecutive games between 1979 and 1982
✓ Northwestern University.fact: At one time, Northwestern had the longest losing streak in Division I-A, losing 34 consecutive games between 1979 and 1982. Following the sudden death of football coach Randy Walker in 2006, 31-year-old former All-American Northwestern linebacker Pat Fitzgerald assumed the position, becoming the youngest Division I FBS coach at the time.
